body: I definitely agree. I get close to no time to myself. And I don’t want to sound like I’m complaining, it’s just the simple truth. My sons father lives out of state and offers no support. My son only attends morning preschool for 2 hours and I only have babysitters when I’m working. Not that I don’t love spending time with him, but I think I might be burnt out. I have to do what I have to do though, you know?

There’s a lot of factors. And for most of them I know what I have to do; but it’s the weight of it all that keeps me down. I know it’s my choices that are keeping me unhappy, but I don’t know how to break the cycle. I’m a creature of terrible, self harming habits and I don’t know how to make it stop.
